title: Python timed task: sponsored walk totals
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: timed practical brief and mark scheme)
intro: Lesson 35. 40 minutes, silent, on your own. Save often; test as you go; keep a short test log.

blocks.text: A masjid youth group held a sponsored walk. Each line of sponsors.csv holds a walker's name and the amount one sponsor pledged, in pounds. A walker can appear on several lines. Write a program that reads the file, ignores any line whose amount is not a positive number (and counts how many it ignored), totals the money for each walker, and writes a report file, totals.txt, listing each walker and their total, then the grand total.

head: Requirement
Marks
rows: Opens and reads the file line by line, splitting each line
Validates the amount: numeric and positive; counts invalid lines
Totals per walker (dictionary or parallel lists)
Writes totals.txt with each walker's total and the grand total
Readable code: comments, meaningful names, a subprogram
Test log with at least three tests

blocks.h: Expected output for the sample file

blocks.text: Yusuf £7.50; Zainab £10.00; Ibrahim £7.50; grand total £25.00; 2 lines ignored.
